# InspiraDo

> InspiraDo is an iPhone app (also on the web at app.inspirado.app) that turns DIY and how-to tutorials saved from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest and the web into organized projects with step-by-step instructions, a materials list, a tools list and a shopping list. Tagline: "Save it. Find it. Do it."

- Save from any app with the iPhone share sheet, or paste a link.
- "Generate project with AI" reads a tutorial's narration and caption (YouTube: the AI watches the video) and lays out steps, materials and tools. Silent videos and carousels: "Add from screenshots".
- Combine several tutorials into one de-duplicated plan. Follow Mode shows one large step at a time, hands-free.
- Always keeps a link to the original creator's post; never downloads or re-hosts videos.
- Pricing: free to save and organize, with 7 AI-built projects included. InspiraDo Pro adds 50 AI-built projects a month for $4.99/month or $39.99/year (US).
- Founder & CEO: Chantel Gia. Contact: hello@inspirado.app
